messages:
maria: pushed three variants for the initial launch tour + sample project badging. quick visual in figma: https://figma.com/f/mock-onboard (please open with :eyes:)
josh: looking now. which metric are we optimizing for — completion or time-to-first-call? :thinking_face:
maria: primary is completion of the quickstart sample (we want devs to hit the API within 5 minutes). secondary is discoverability of sample projects.
anya: initial pass: Variant A (top persistent badge) feels the most discoverable but contrast on the badge label is low — meets neither AA small text nor large text. also missing keyboard focus on the badge sequence.
dom: implementation note: persistent banner will require a small server-side flag so we can reliably hide it after complete. client-only localStorage will be flaky across devices.
leo: small UX nit — if we auto-create a sample project on click, make the CTA explicit: "Create sample project" vs "Open sample". otherwise users think it's just a preview.
anya: also suggest adding aria-live="polite" to the progress updates so screen reader users get status as they step through the tour. and ensure focus trap doesn't lock keyboard users out of nav bar.
mar ia: typo in my message :sweat_smile: (should be maria). updated copy suggestions below — please pick one and we can A/B.

maria: ```
Variant A banner CTA: "Create sample project — 3 steps"
Variant B modal CTA: "Start guided tour"
Variant C inline rail CTA: "Browse sample projects"
``` 
josh: prefer a short CTA — we saw better CTR with verbs first. maybe "Create sample" or "Start tour". telemetry: event names please, e.g., `onboard.banner_click`, `onboard.modal_start`.
anya: design accessibility fixes: increase badge bg to #1f3a93 (meets contrast), button hover & focus 3px outline, reduce copy length to one line. sample project cards: ensure alt text for images and at least 16px font size.
design-bot: a11y scan results: Variant B modal has color-contrast fail on secondary text (contrast ratio 3.4:1). Keyboard order check passed for A and C, failed for B due to modals not returning focus to launch button.
dom: note on rollout: we can ship A quickly, but B requires modal focus management changes. timeline: A in 2 sprints, B in 3. i'll flag dependency for experiments infra to track exposures.
leo: copy tweak: for intl, avoid idioms like "Get rolling". also add link to docs in the modal footer: "Learn more about samples".
anya: one more: for screen readers, the sample scaffolding flow should present a short summary after creation with a link and command snippet. e.g., `redwood samples run <name>` (placeholder)
maria: ok great. next steps: 1) dom to add server flag + experiment hooks; 2) anya to push a11y fixes and updated comps; 3) leo to finalize CTA copy and i18n strings; 4) josh to add telemetry names to the experiment ticket. i'll file the ticket and attach the figma link. thanks all :sparkles:
josh: LGTM. can we get one quick usability smoke test with 3 new hires? 5 mins each. 
dom: will add the flag PR draft and link it in the ticket.
anya: i'll attach updated comps and a checklist for keyboard/a11y test cases.
maria: filing ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-712 — feel free to add comments. will also schedule the 5-min smoke tests for tomorrow. :robot_face:
